correctness.rationale: The original Lin–Sturmfels/Borodin–Rains determinantal-point variety is GL2(C)^n invariant. The diagonal cocharacter with powers-of-two weights yields pairwise distinct weights on 2^n standard tensor coordinates, hence these are the only ambient projective fixed points. Their membership is not assumed: for diagonal A,B, phi(A,B)_I=prod_{i in I}a_i prod_{i notin I}b_i, and 0/1 choices realize each coordinate point. The variety therefore contains all 2^n fixed points and no more. Euler C* localization gives chi_top(V_n)=2^n; ambient complement has chi_c=0. Independent code checked 510 such coordinate specializations for n<=8; proof holds all n.

originality.rationale: Borodin–Rains arXiv:math-ph/0409059 Theorem 4.2 proves GL2(C)^n semidirect Sn invariance and Theorem 4.4 dimensions/whole ambient through n<=3. Lin–Sturmfels arXiv:0812.0601 gives projective map/closedness, algebraic relations and same natural invariance. Neither main theorem computes Euler characteristic. The symmetric-principal-minor subvariety having analogous Euler value does not imply the general locus value (Euler is not monotone under inclusion).
